_doc: Pricing for /api/v1/* in micro-euros (1 EUR = 1_000_000). First matching path-pattern wins; unmatched paths fall back to the catch-all `_default`. Free paths (matched by services/api_keys/scopes.FREE_PATH_PATTERNS) bypass metering entirely.

patterns.label: full-text retrieval
patterns._doc: API v2 mirror of the v1 full-text cost tier (Cellar / LEG XML passthrough).

patterns.label: heavy compute (legal-text TF-IDF)
patterns._doc: API v2 mirror of the v1 legal-text heavy-compute tier (v2 nests these under /laws/{celex}/).

patterns.label: heavy compute (cross-reference graph aggregation)
patterns._doc: Aggregates Cellar metadata + relationships + EuroVoc; cache-first via law_xref.

patterns.label: lightweight read
patterns._doc: Aggregate counts — keep ahead of the proprietary content-retrieval pattern below.

patterns.label: content retrieval (full guide / translation / report body)
patterns._doc: Detail endpoints return full markdown / may inline a 30-500 KB HTML body (cached 6h).

patterns.label: content retrieval (per-org news items with bodies)
patterns._doc: Returns up to 50 dated news items each with body_txt/body_html. The directory list + /types fall to _default.

patterns.label: content retrieval (ECB/SSM item with full body)
patterns._doc: Detail endpoints for the ECB folder return the full body_txt/body_html (news/speeches HTML, publications PDF text). List endpoints + the /api/v2/ecb directory fall to _default.

patterns.label: full-text retrieval
patterns._doc: Cellar / LEG XML passthrough; cached after first fetch.

patterns.label: content retrieval (full committee meeting transcript)
patterns._doc: Detail endpoint always returns the full Whisper transcript (40-140 KB). The list endpoint stays at _default. Matches both v1 and v2.

patterns.label: content retrieval (committee agenda document)
patterns._doc: Detail fetches + parses the doceo agenda PDF (cached after first access). Matches both v1 and v2.

patterns.label: content retrieval (full Council register item body)
patterns._doc: Detail endpoints for the 8 Council-of-the-EU register surfaces return the full stored body. List endpoints fall to _default. Matches both v1 and v2 (the optional /council/ segment).

patterns.label: content retrieval (full European Council item body)
patterns._doc: Detail endpoints for the 6 European Council surfaces return the full stored body. List endpoints fall to _default. Matches both v1 and v2.

patterns.label: content retrieval (full Eurogroup item body)
patterns._doc: Detail endpoints for the 5 Eurogroup surfaces return the full stored body. List endpoints fall to _default. Matches both v1 and v2.

patterns.label: content retrieval (EP eMeeting agenda tree / document with all-language PDFs)
patterns._doc: Detail endpoints for /emeeting and /emeeting-documents return the full document tree / all-language PDF URLs. List endpoints fall to _default. Matches both v1 and v2.
